findings.area: Progress leaderboard, viewer inside a big tie group beyond the 20-row page
findings.title: No gap marker between the 20th row and the viewer when the viewer is tied with hidden students
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r14-B/lbui.mjs (token bigtie): API total 26, rows 20 all rank 1, me rank 1 (name sorts last); UI lists 20 rows then '#1 You' directly, count 'Showing 21 of 26 ranked students.' and no gap row; screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r14-B/shots/lbui-phone-bigtie.png
findings.expected: A visible gap whenever the listed rows and the viewer row are not adjacent in the server order (5 tied students are hidden between them).
findings.actual: describeBoard decides the gap from rank (me.rank > rows.length + 1); with ties the viewer's rank (1) says nothing about position, so the list looks contiguous.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/lib/progression.ts describeBoard (last lines): gap = showMe && !unranked && board.total > shown (hidden students exist) instead of a rank comparison.

findings.area: 429 handling: Retry-After header (R13 fix) edge cases
findings.title: A readable Retry-After header is ignored when the 429 body carries details without retryAfterSeconds, and an absurd header prints '1666666667 minutes'
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r14-B/ra.mjs: 'details {} + hdr 30', 'details [] + hdr 30', 'body retry 0 + hdr 30' all give 'Too many requests. Please wait a moment, then try again.' (header 30 unused); 'hdr 99999999999' gives 'Try again in 1666666667 minutes.'. Normal cases hold: header-only 42 gives 'Try again in 42 seconds.' once, no duplicated sentence, on 15 surfaces (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r14-B/x1-429.out, 240 variants, 0 flags).
findings.expected: Header used whenever the body has no usable retryAfterSeconds; absurd waits capped or phrased as 'a long time'.
findings.actual: web/src/lib/api.ts errorFrom reads the header only when details is undefined/null; spokenWait in web/src/ui/state.tsx has no ceiling. Proxy-only situations (the real API always sends both).
findings.fix_hint: web/src/lib/api.ts errorFrom (~line 75): merge retryAfterSeconds when details lacks a positive numeric retryAfterSeconds; web/src/ui/state.tsx spokenWait: cap.

findings.area: Leaderboard normalizer and describeBoard with contradictory figures
findings.title: Contradictory or fractional leaderboard payloads render a plausible board instead of an error
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r14-B/lbpay.mjs (28 mutations; every missing or mistyped field alerts correctly) but: 'total 0 rows>0' shows 'Nobody is ranked yet' hiding 20 rows; 'rows empty total>0' shows only the gap and '#41 You ... Showing 1 of 41'; 'row rank 0' shows '#0'; 'row xp 1.5' shows '1.5 XP'; 'total 2.5' accepted; 'me null' with total>0 shows the board without the viewer.
findings.expected: A payload whose figures contradict each other (total 0 with rows, rows empty with total>0, rank < 1, non-integer xp or total) is an 'unexpected response' alert (invariant: an incomplete payload never becomes a plausible default).
findings.actual: readRow uses nonNeg (accepts 0 and fractions) and describeBoard returns 'nobody' on total === 0 regardless of rows. Only reachable with a buggy server or proxy; same class as R13-C-08.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/lib/guard.ts add integer/positive guards; web/src/lib/progression.ts normalizeLeaderboard: throw PayloadError when total===0 but rows exist, rows empty but total>0, or rank < 1.
